tools.name: is_job_still_open
tools.description: Whether a job posting is still on the employer's own careers site (VeritaHire re-reads employer sites and marks a posting closed within about 36 hours of it leaving): open, closed or unknown, with the last time it was confirmed. Works for any employer's posting, given its careers-site link.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "employers" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_job_posting, request_competitive_hiring_report · Public sink: request_competitive_hiring_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_job_posting, request_competitive_hiring_report · Public sink: request_competitive_hiring_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare_job_posting" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
